2610.13912.title: RSI-Anything: Unlocking Recursive Self-Improvement with World Models
2610.13912.paper_summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) aims to transform interaction experience into persistent improvements, yet external feedback is costly and world-model predictions may become unreliable as policies evolve. We introduce RSI-Anything, a domain-general framework built on JEPA-Anything that uses predictive world models to guide action and learning-data selection. Observed feedback drives policy or workflow improvement and conditional world-model adaptation, while component and compatibility checks govern the retention of updated policy-model pairs. Across diverse computational and scientific domains, RSI-Anything demonstrates substantial gains. In code repair, with the coder fixed, success increases from 26.3% with a static verifier to 29.2% through predictive selection and 31.2% after world-model adaptation, at comparable test usage. Graphical user interface (GUI) evaluations showed higher task completion, while average actions decrease by 39.4%. Across five successive policy versions, laboratory-planning scores more than double from 21.80% to 46.01%. In reaction optimization, RSI-Anything achieves 96.15% mean best observed yield versus 82.16% for Bayesian optimization under the same 40-experiment budget. An end-to-end immune-science application further connects workflow evolution and predictive modeling with therapeutic hypothesis generation. These results demonstrate how predictive world models and retained system updates enable recursive improvement across diverse environments.
2610.13912.paper_summary_zh: 遞歸自我改善（RSI）旨在將互動體驗轉化為持久的改進，然而外部反饋成本高昂，隨著政策的演變，世界模型的預測可能變得不可靠。我們介紹了RSI-Anything，一個基於JEPA-Anything的領域通用框架，利用預測世界模型來指導行動和學習數據的選擇。觀察到的反饋推動政策或工作流程的改進以及條件世界模型的適應，而組件和相容性檢查則管理更新的政策模型對的保留。在各種計算和科學領域中，RSI-Anything顯示出顯著的增益。在代碼修復方面，當編碼器固定時，成功率從使用靜態驗證器的26.3%提高到通過預測選擇的29.2%，並在世界模型適應後達到31.2%，且測試使用量相當。圖形用戶界面（GUI）評估顯示任務完成率更高，而平均行動數減少了39.4%。在五個連續的政策版本中，實驗室規劃分數從21.80%翻倍增至46.01%。在反應優化中，RSI-Anything在相同的40次實驗預算下實現了96.15%的平均最佳觀察產量，而貝葉斯優化則為82.16%。一個端到端的免疫科學應用進一步將工作流程演變和預測建模與治療假設生成聯繫起來。這些結果展示了預測世界模型和保留的系統更新如何在各種環境中實現遞歸改善。
